bullets.text: A heatwave affected Verlow from 22 June 2026, with the Provincial Public Health Institute issuing a public warning on 23 June.
Extreme heat placed strain on the power network, with the network operator Grennet Power issuing a warning and load shedding referenced by the third day.
No casualty figures were reported within the window; service at Verlow General Hospital was disrupted on the fourth day.
The Provincial Public Health Institute and Grennet Power deployed resources and the institute asked for assistance, with the situation still developing at the end of the window.
The Provincial Public Health Institute issues a heat warning for Verlow on the morning of the second day.
The institute asks for assistance concerning Verlow and deploys within the same hour.
Service at Verlow General Hospital is disrupted on the morning of the fourth day.
Grennet Power, the network operator, issues a warning and deploys as load shedding is reported.
